text: So tell me about Tokyo. What's it like?
I love it. There are so many great things to do. I'm busy all the time.
Well, It's okay. One thing I do like is that there's very little noise. People don't walk down the street with loud radios or anything. It's pretty nice.
It's okay. But it's awfully crowded and the air is so dirty. To tell you the truth, I'm thinking about moving.
What's it like living in New York?
Oh, it's really a great city, but you have to pay a fortune for everything.
Is Auckland a very big city? Is it crowded?
Not really. It's really quite small. It's never very crowded or noisy. In fact, it's like a small town in many ways.
So what's San Francisco like? I hear it's very scenic.
Yes, it is. The Golden Gate Bridge is great any time of the year. The parks and the ocean are beautiful, too. It really is a very lovely city.
What's your hometown like? Is it a nice place to live?
It's great, especially for families with children. It's pretty and quiet and it isn't dangerous at all.
Sure. That's why I like it. Lots of people. Lots of nightclubs and discos. I don't like small cities.
